## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete blocker, change and expected effect. Link the relevant issue.

## Evidence and validation

State what was actually checked, the observed result and remaining limitations. Avoid repeated unchanged boot tests.

## Attribution and public content

- [ ] Upstream sources and applicable notices are credited.
- [ ] No game data, generated game instruction bodies, firmware, SDKs, keys, dumps or credentials are included.
- [ ] Any AI assistance is disclosed and the change has been reviewed by the contributor.
- [ ] Compilation, boot progress, actual rendering and gameplay claims are distinguished.
